title: post-stamped: every post's first line is a signature `<lane>#<n> · <account> · <session>`, and a post without one is refused
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Filed by the triage seat (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`), 2026-10-28 ~06:2xZ. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The maintainer's words (verbatim, in order)

1. 「还有一个问题是我看到回复，但是不知道是哪个 账户回复的，哪个车道回复的。」
2. On the triage seat's proposal: 「同意 让发帖脚本 post-stamped 强制每条帖子第一行带署名：车道#席位号 · 账户 · 会话，缺署名就拒发。」

## Why

Every seat posts through the fleet relay, so GitHub shows every comment as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`. Headers are not uniform. Some name a seat and session (`· triage seat · session_…`), some name neither, and almost none name the account. So the maintainer reading a thread cannot tell which lane, which seat or which Claude account wrote a reply.

## Wanted

1. **The signature line.** The first non-empty line of every body that `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` writes is:
   `<lane>#<n> · <account> · <session>`
   - `<lane>#<n>`: the seat, as the seat roster names it. Examples: `domain:ui#1`, `domain:server#2`, `domain:skills#1`, `repo:cloud#2`, `repo:hotcrm#1`, `triage#1`, `director#1`.
   - `<account>`: the account the seat runs under, the same value a claim's `Account:` line carries (for example `os-zhuang`, `os-justin`, `huangyiirene`).
   - `<session>`: the full `session_…` id.
   - Example: `domain:ui#1 · os-zhuang · session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT`
2. **Refuse without it.** `post-stamped` refuses (non-zero exit, nothing sent) when the first non-empty line does not match the shape, naming the expected shape in the refusal. ⛔ No silent auto-insert. It may offer `--sign-from <seat-post>` to fill the line from the seat's own roster entry, but a body without a signature is never posted.
3. **The same rule on the other writers.** The other seat-authored writers through the relay apply it too: `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs` bodies, and `comment_edit` / `issue_patch` in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` when they write a seat-authored body. Generated workflow cards (the full-run card, the queue-flake anchor) are out of scope: they are authored by a workflow, and their marker line says so.
4. **Machine-shaped records keep working.** Every recogniser that reads a seat artefact by its first line skips one leading signature line before matching. That covers `## Contract review`, `os-dev-report`, `Contract-review-claim:`, `Contract-review-handoff:`, `Brief-claimed-by:`, claim and release lines, round records, and `## 席位核对`. Pin each with a test that the same body is recognised with and without the signature line.
5. **The skill says it once.** One line in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md` (or wherever the posting rule lives) states the signature and points to the refusal. Edit within existing lines where possible; the files are near their line ceilings.

## Surface

- `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs`, `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`, `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`, and every other parser that keys on a first line, plus their tests.
- One line in the pm-dispatch skill. Tier S (`.claude/**`) plus non-gate `scripts/pm/**`.
- `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Acceptance

- `post-stamped` with a body whose first line is not a signature exits non-zero and sends nothing. With a signature, it posts as today.
- Every recogniser's existing fixtures pass with a signature line prepended.
- The next round record, claim and review record from any seat carry the signature line, and the maintainer can read lane, seat, account and session off the first line of any reply.

Dedupe: open `domain:skills` issues read for `post-stamped`, `signature`, `署名`, `account`: none. **New.**
